import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

One shared small network scores each placement at every layer, and a learned softmax gate over layers combines the scores. import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.005}

CTX = 32
LW = 32
PROJ = 16
HID = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        Z = self.Z
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = spec.in_channels
        self.ctx1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, CTX, 1)
        self.ctx2 = nn.Conv2d(CTX, CTX, 3, padding=1)
        self.ctx_to_layer = nn.Conv2d(CTX, LW, 1)
        self.lin = nn.Conv2d(12 + Z, LW, 1)
        self.l2 = nn.Conv2d(LW, LW, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(LW, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 2, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * CTX, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        # 2D column context
        c = F.relu(self.ctx1(obs))
        f = F.relu(c + self.ctx2(c))
        ctx_l = self.ctx_to_layer(f)  # [B, LW, Y, X]
        # per-layer inputs
        grid = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        below = F.pad(grid, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :, :Z]
        above = F.pad(grid, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, :, 1:]
        eye = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype)
        pos = eye.reshape(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        lay = torch.cat([grid, below, above, pos], dim=1)  # [B, 12+Z, Z, Y, X]
        lay = lay.permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(B * Z, 12 + Z, Y, X)
        ctx_b = ctx_l.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, LW, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, LW, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.lin(lay) + ctx_b)
        h = F.relu(h + self.l2(h))
        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            u = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            o = out(u).reshape(B, Z, 2, Y, X)
            score = o[:, :, 0]
            gate = torch.softmax(o[:, :, 1], dim=1)
            res.append((gate * score).sum(1).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.005}

COL1 = 96
COL2 = 64
CTX = 32
PROJ = 48
HID = 48


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        cin = spec.in_channels
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, COL1, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(COL1, COL2, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.ctx_in = nn.Conv2d(COL2, CTX, 1)
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(CTX, CTX, 3, padding=1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(COL2 + CTX, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])

        k = F.relu(self.ctx_in(c))
        k = F.relu(k + self.ctx(k))
        f = torch.cat([c, k], dim=1)
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []

        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.005}

COL1 = 96
COL2 = 64
PROJ = 48
HID = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        cin = spec.in_channels
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, COL1, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(COL1, COL2, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(COL2, PROJ, 1)
        convs = []
        for dy, dx in self.fps:
            k = 2 * max(dy, dx) - 1
            convs.append(nn.Conv2d(PROJ, HID, k, padding=k // 2))
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(convs)
        self.mids = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * COL2, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        c = self.col(obs)
        p = F.relu(self.proj(c))
        res = []
        for conv, mid, out in zip(self.convs, self.mids, self.outs):
            h = F.relu(conv(p))
            h = F.relu(mid(h))
            res.append(out(h).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([c.mean((2, 3)), c.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.01}

W = 40
FC = 256


def add_coords(obs):
    B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
    ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
    xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
    return torch.cat([obs, ys, xs], dim=1)


class Trunk(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin):
        super().__init__()
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin + 2, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 48, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(48, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, obs):
        c = self.col(add_coords(obs))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(c))
        return F.relu(x + self.c2(x))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.trunk = Trunk(int(spec.in_channels))
        self.loc = nn.Conv2d(W, 24, 3, padding=1)
        self.loc_out = nn.Conv2d(24, self.T, 1)
        sq = max(2, min(16, 1024 // (Y * X)))
        self.sq = nn.Conv2d(W, sq, 1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(sq * Y * X, FC)
        self.fc_out = nn.Linear(FC, int(spec.n_place))
        nn.init.normal_(self.fc_out.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.fc_out.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64 + FC, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64 + FC, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        f = self.trunk(obs)
        local = self.loc_out(F.relu(self.loc(f))).flatten(1)
        h = F.relu(self.fc(F.relu(self.sq(f)).flatten(1)))
        place = local + self.fc_out(h)
        gp = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        g = torch.cat([gp, h], dim=1)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.01}

W = 40
P = 16


def add_coords(obs):
    B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
    ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
    xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
    return torch.cat([obs, ys, xs], dim=1)


class Trunk(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin):
        super().__init__()
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin + 2, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 48, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(48, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, obs):
        c = self.col(add_coords(obs))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(c))
        return F.relu(x + self.c2(x))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.trunk = Trunk(int(spec.in_channels))
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, P, 1)
        views = []
        trs = [False, True] if Y == X else [False]
        for tr in trs:
            for fl in ([], [2], [3], [2, 3]):
                views.append((tr, fl))
        self.views = views
        self.vconv = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(P, P, 3, padding=1) for _ in views])
        self.vout = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(P, T, 1) for _ in views])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        f = self.trunk(obs)
        p = F.relu(self.proj(f))
        place = None
        for (tr, fl), conv, out in zip(self.views, self.vconv, self.vout):
            v = p.transpose(2, 3) if tr else p
            if len(fl) > 0:
                v = torch.flip(v, fl)
            o = out(F.relu(conv(v))).flatten(1)
            place = o if place is None else place + o
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 8, "lr": 0.0005, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01}

W = 40
H = 32


def add_coords(obs):
    B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
    ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
    xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
    return torch.cat([obs, ys, xs], dim=1)


class Trunk(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin):
        super().__init__()
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin + 2, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 48, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(48, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, obs):
        c = self.col(add_coords(obs))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(c))
        return F.relu(x + self.c2(x))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.trunk = Trunk(int(spec.in_channels))
        self.head = nn.Conv2d(W, H, 3, padding=1)
        self.mid = nn.Conv2d(H, H, 1)
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(H, T, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        f = self.trunk(obs)
        h = F.relu(self.head(f))
        h = F.relu(self.mid(h))
        place = self.out(h).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([c.mean((2, 3)), c.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.0015, "ent_coef": 0.01}

W = 48
K = 8
H = 32
G = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        T = int(spec.n_types)
        cin = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, 64, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.sq = nn.Conv2d(W, K, 1)
        self.amap = nn.Linear(K * Y * X, int(spec.n_place))
        self.loc = nn.Conv2d(W, H, 3, padding=1)
        self.loc_out = nn.Conv2d(H, T, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        c = self.col(obs)
        x = F.relu(c + self.c1(c))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        s = self.sq(f).flatten(1)
        local = self.loc_out(F.relu(self.loc(f))).flatten(1)
        place = self.amap(s) + local
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds. The default recipe gives only 32 PPO updates of 4,096 samples each, which is probably too few for exact builds. Fewer PPO epochs buy more samples, and smaller rollouts give more updates. So two candidates keep the starting network and test recipe changes (2 epochs vs 1). The third tests a structural idea that fits this task. A brick's outcome depends on which layer it lands on (the maximum build height under its footprint) and on whether the footprint cells at that layer are all target cells. So I score each placement separately per layer, using features shared across layers, and use a learned softmax gate over layers to pick the landing layer. That network uses fewer FLOPs than the starting one, so the budget does not shrink. It uses candidate A's recipe, so the two can be compared directly.
analyses.2: Every trial so far scored 0 on dev and 0 on training success: the starting net with 2 epochs, the starting net with 1 epoch, and a per-layer gated net. Recipe changes alone (1 to 2 epochs, 230k to 400k samples) did not help, so sample count is probably not the bottleneck. My working guess is that the policy cannot reliably tell which placements are exactly right, i.e. that the brick lands in missing target cells and seals nothing below. That needs clean per-column features pooled over each footprint. The starting net only gets them after two 3x3 convolutions that blur neighbouring cells. A second risk is collapse onto DONE: random placements score negative, DONE scores 0. Entropy is the lever that can be pulled legitimately against that. This round tests three things. (1) A column MLP feeding footprint pooling directly. (2) A learned 3x3 placement head with no pooling, which still works if the anchor convention differs from the one described. (3) Net (1) with higher entropy.
analyses.3: All six trials scored exactly 0, on both dev and training success. That includes two recipes (1 or 2 epochs), higher entropy, a per-layer network, a column MLP and a pooled head, and r2c2's anchor-agnostic 3x3 head. Seed noise cannot explain this. I see two likely causes. (1) Every network so far assumes action index t*Y*X + y*X + x lines up spatially with obs cell (y, x). If this world transposes or flips that mapping, no translation-equivariant head can learn, which would match the total failure. (2) Optimisation or credit assignment is too weak for exact builds at this budget. This round tests both. A adds a fully connected action head that can learn any cell-to-action mapping, on top of a local head. B adds one local head for each of the 8 flips and transposes of the grid. C keeps the standard alignment and changes only the recipe: longer horizon, lower lr, more updates.
analyses.4: All 9 trials (18 seeds) scored 0 on dev, and their train success was also 0. That covers the starting net with 1, 2 or 4 epochs, entropy 0.005 to 0.03, gamma 0.95 or 0.99, per-layer gates, learned 3x3 per-type heads (which work for any anchor), and 8 dihedral views. In the world as described, a simple local rule should be easy to learn and would complete many targets: place a 1x1 brick where the landing cell is missing, then DONE. So local nets that handle isometries and anchor offsets failing every time suggests this world differs in a way local structure cannot fit. The likely cause is a mapping from action index to cell that is not an isometry, possibly with scrambled observation cells too. The only global head so far (r3c1, FC behind a 256-unit ReLU bottleneck, plus a competing local head) is weak evidence against this. The last round therefore tests direct learned linear maps from cells to actions, with and without spatial convolutions.
